assertions.predicate: After merge and Studio installation, verify installed source ancestry, then run python3 ops/corpus-render-gate-selftest.py from that checkout. This runnable probe starts real hook processes with a synthetic symlinked HOME and checks absolute, relative, HOME, tilde, dot, parent, and repeated-slash write spellings plus reads and malformed events. It classifies commands without executing writes. The worker-release-smoke.v1 runner checks release identity only and does not attest this separate installed-hook probe.
assertions.expected_result: The installed corpus-render selftest exits 0 with every case passing. Missing source ancestry or probe output leaves installed behavior unproven.
assertions.input_class: Installed hook and synthetic temporary HOME paths; commands are classified, never executed
